title: mentha × verticillata var. prachinensis
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. prachinensis, commonly known as Thai mint, is a hybrid species of mint that combines the characteristics of Mentha × verticillata and Mentha prachinensis. This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of colds and fever. The therapeutic actions of Thai mint include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene. The bioactive constituents of Thai mint have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
